name: ifm
description: Personal work workflows dispatched by name, including Jira root-cause updates and Copilot review cycles.

interface.shortDescription: Run a named personal work workflow.
interface.longDescription: Dispatches personal work workflows by name. Use `root cause` to update a related Jira ticket, `review` to process comments and request the next Copilot review, or `create pr` to open a pull request.
